tmpdir.description: Specifies a location to place temporary files, other than the default.

pristine_tar_opts.description: Defines default command line options to be assumed by pristine-tar. Overrides PRISTINE_TAR env var if set via CLI.

xdelta_tool.description: Defines the underlying binary delta tool to be used for new deltas. Supported values are "xdelta3" and "xdelta".
